text:
maya: FYI — AcmeCorp reporting SSO failures after IdP cert rotation. Getting 'Assertion recipient mismatch' and 403 at our ACS.
liam: Can you paste the error we see in the gateway logs and the ACS URL the customer is sending? Any recent metadata fetches?
maya: Gateway log: `saml: assertion rejected: SubjectConfirmationData Recipient mismatch (expected=https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs, got=https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/)` — notice trailing slash. Customer says they rotated certs yesterday; our metadata fetch picked up two signing certs (old + new) but order changed.
ash: Trailing slash vs no slash is a classic. Do we canonicalize recipient URIs before comparison? Our SAML lib is strict.
maya: Repro steps from customer:
```
POST /saml/acs HTTP/1.1
Host: app.redwood-inference.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
SAMLResponse=<base64-xml-with-Recipient="https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/">
```
liam: Also seeing in IdP metadata the x509cert that expires in 48h and another newly-published cert. The rotation likely switched which KeyDescriptor is first. Some IdPs update metadata order which our verifier picks as primary.
maya: Customer tried re-uploading metadata and still failing. They can't change their ACS to remove trailing slash quickly — it's baked into their proxy.
ash: Short-term mitigation: Add an ACS alias in our SP config that includes the trailing-slash variant. That should accept the response while we fix strict matching. Can support add the alias on the tenant? @liam can you allow per-tenant fallback for recipient normalization?
liam: I can push a tenant-level config change (add ACS alias) for AcmeCorp now. Will also open an engineering task to normalize recipient matching (strip trailing slash) in the SAML validation path. ETA for config change: 15m. Patch ETA: next 48h.
maya: Customer wants a workaround now — please run the config change and I’ll confirm.
ash: Quick note: we should not weaken checks broadly. We'll scope alias to this customer only and log every acceptance for 7 days.
maya: Also seeing occasional SignedResponse validation errors referencing the old cert thumbprint. Might be because some IdP nodes still sign with old key; we need to accept both certs while they finish rolling out.
liam: Agree. Add both x509 certs from IdP metadata to the accepted signing cert list for the tenant. That plus ACS alias should fix immediate failures.
maya: I'll tell customer to test in 20m and share logs. Ticket: ACME-789. Thanks :thumbsup:
sso-bot: Created escalation JIRA ACME-789, severity=P2, assignee=liam, link=https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-789 :warning:
liam: Filed engineering task ENG-2021 to normalize recipient checks and add metadata-order-resilience. Putting a canary roll for SAML lib to avoid regressions.
maya: Customer confirmed — sign-ins succeeded after tenant alias & cert accept. Will monitor for 24h and schedule a follow-up to close. :white_check_mark:
ash: After patch we should add a regression test: IdP metadata with swapped key order + ACS trailing slash variants.
liam: Copy. I'll include tests and a migration plan for strict-mode opt-in.
maya: Thanks team. Keeping open until cert expiry passes.
